assumptions: 1. BEFORE (baseline) = 24-hour HRT scenario of the Aquaivolt 2,000-scenario dataset: 66.15 m3/d biogas, 63.63% CH4, 42.09 m3/d methane, 151.07 kWh/d electricity (55,140 kWh/yr).
2. AFTER = the same baseline with a research-backed biogas increase of +40.00% to +50.00%, swept linearly across 200 scenarios on six pathways (co-digestion and pre-treatment).

3. Literature anchors: FW+GW co-digestion +44.96% (PubMed 35882315); PS/FW 1:3 +52% (PMC10241376); 8% NaOH +40-55% (Springer 10.1007/s12649-023-02350-x); steam explosion +56% (MDPI); combined steam+NaOH+laccase +49% (MDPI); microwave + co-digestion +52% (PubMed 26320815). Results above 50% were derated to the 40-50% band.

4. Operating parameters vary within realistic ranges: HRT 15-25 h; mesophilic 36.5-39 C (P1/P2/P5/P6), thermophilic 50-55 C (P4); pH 6.9-7.4; OLR 3-5 kg VS/m3/d; CH4 60-65%; H2S 180-260 ppm inlet with 90-95% removal; stability index 80-95%.
5. Electricity = methane x 3.5892 kWh/m3 (9.97 kWh/m3 x 36% engine efficiency). Gross output, before heating, pumping, mixing and gas-cleaning loads.
6. Green columns = BEFORE values (constant baseline); yellow columns = AFTER and increase values.

7. This is a research-based planning simulation, NOT plant measurement. Gains are substrate- and condition-specific and often shrink at full scale; pilot testing is required before investor or grant claims.
8. The original 2,000-scenario file reached only +28.5% via HRT change alone; the 40-50% band requires co-digestion and/or pre-treatment as modeled here.
